saturation_assessment.basis: Questions 21–47 and their keyed answers are supported by the cited source passages. I found no unsupported rule claims, ambiguous scenarios that prevent a determinate source-based answer, or duplicates that fail to add a distinct outcome or rule interpretation. The closest overlaps still test distinct branches: Q38 tests the fewer-than-five-car Adrenaline branch and turn-order eligibility; Q41 tests whether multiple qualifying neighboring cars multiply one Slipstream action; Q43 contrasts pre-finish and post-finish corners; Q44 isolates intermediate-lap finish-line behavior; and Q47 tests Cluttered Hand after the gear adjustment. The ledger maps the core procedural passages and records two subsequent targeted passes with no qualifying additions. Further candidates I checked either restate covered branches, recombine covered mechanics without a new timing or exception ruling, or require rules outside this source.
